description: When storage is a top priority, the West Lake 7 Drawer Dresser delivers. Seven dovetailed drawers with full-extension glides provide abundant space for your growing child's wardrobe, from baby clothing through school-age favorites. Solid hardwood construction and a warm Brown Maple finish create a piece that's as durable as it is beautiful. The spacious top is ready for a changing pad during the early years. Non-toxic, baby-safe finish throughout. Coordinates with the complete West Lake collection.
